name: CKEditor 5 Dev tools
description: Attaches the official CKEditor 5 Inspector to every editor instance, adds an admin report of all registered CKEditor 5 plugins, and ships a plugin starter template.
library_dependencies: ckeditor/ckeditor5-inspector (v5.0.0, external, loaded from unpkg CDN)
project_description: Developer tooling for CKEditor 5 in Drupal. Enables the official CKEditor 5 Inspector (a debugging overlay) on any page carrying an initialized CKEditor 5 instance, adds an admin report at /admin/reports/ckeditor5-plugins listing every registered CKEditor 5 plugin definition (label, id, provided HTML elements, providing module), and bundles a copy-and-rename starter template in ckeditor5_plugin_starter_template/ for building modules that provide custom CKEditor 5 plugins. Should not be enabled in production.
